name: @open-deltat/cli
description: Book time on a deltat calendar from the terminal: find what is free, hold it, commit it, and watch changes live. Human output by default, --json for scripts and AI agents.
author: Simon Orzel

scripts.build: cd ../client && bun run build && cd ../cli && tsc
scripts.prepublishOnly: cd ../client && bun run build && cd ../cli && tsc
scripts.compile: bun run build && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile build/deltat-cli
